#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Allow-listed, deterministic SQL metadata audits for EDARSAHUB Worker.

Jobs select a fixed profile only. They cannot provide SQL text. All access uses
core.sql_first.db.readonly_sql_connection and statements are SELECT/WITH only.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
if str(BACKEND) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))

from core.sql_first.db import readonly_sql_connection

PROFILE_GATE1 = "gate1_connections_internationalization"
TARGET_NAMES = {
    "Sistema_Capacidades",
    "Sistema_TiposVariantes",
    "Sistema_Sync_Catalogo",
    "Sistema_VersionesSistemas",
    "Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion",
    "Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion",
    "Servidores_Conexiones",
    "Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad",
}
KEYWORDS = (
    "empresa", "unidad", "timezone", "zona", "pais", "country",
    "moneda", "currency", "divisa", "cambio", "fx", "idioma",
    "locale", "preferencia", "credencial", "secreto", "homolog",
    "layout", "evidencia", "ejecucion", "externo", "software",
    "version", "sync", "capacidad", "conexion", "connection",
)


def rows(cursor):
    names = [item[0] for item in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(names, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def select(cursor, statement: str):
    normalized = " ".join(statement.strip().split()).upper()
    if not (normalized.startswith("SELECT ") or normalized.startswith("WITH ")):
        raise RuntimeError("READ_ONLY_SQL_GUARD_REJECTED")
    prohibited = (" INSERT ", " UPDATE ", " DELETE ", " MERGE ", " DROP ", " ALTER ", " CREATE ", " TRUNCATE ", " EXEC ", " EXECUTE ")
    padded = " " + normalized + " "
    if any(token in padded for token in prohibited):
        raise RuntimeError("READ_ONLY_SQL_GUARD_REJECTED")
    cursor.execute(statement)
    return rows(cursor)


def safe_ids(values):
    return ",".join(str(value) for value in sorted({int(v) for v in values}))


def run_gate1():
    evidence = {
        "schema": "edarsahub.sql-readonly-audit.v1",
        "profile": PROFILE_GATE1,
        "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "read_only": True,
        "ddl": False,
        "dml": False,
    }
    with readonly_sql_connection() as connection:
        cursor = connection.cursor()
        evidence["database_identity"] = select(cursor, "SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user")
        tables = select(cursor, "SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS object_name,t.object_id,t.create_date,t.modify_date FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id ORDER BY s.name,t.name")
        related = []
        exact = []
        for item in tables:
            name = str(item.get("object_name") or "")
            lowered = name.lower()
            if name in TARGET_NAMES:
                exact.append(item)
            if name in TARGET_NAMES or any(keyword in lowered for keyword in KEYWORDS):
                related.append(item)
        evidence["target_objects"] = exact
        evidence["related_objects"] = related[:500]
        ids = safe_ids(item["object_id"] for item in related[:500] if item.get("object_id") is not None)
        if ids:
            evidence["columns"] = select(cursor, f"SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE t.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id")
            evidence["indexes"] = select(cursor, f"SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS object_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.type_desc,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY s.name,t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id")
            evidence["foreign_keys"] = select(cursor, f"SELECT sch1.name AS schema_name,t1.name AS table_name,fk.name AS fk_name,c1.name AS column_name,sch2.name AS referenced_schema,t2.name AS referenced_table,c2.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables t1 ON t1.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch1 ON sch1.schema_id=t1.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c1 ON c1.object_id=t1.object_id AND c1.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables t2 ON t2.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch2 ON sch2.schema_id=t2.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c2 ON c2.object_id=t2.object_id AND c2.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE t1.object_id IN ({ids}) OR t2.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY sch1.name,t1.name,fk.name")
        else:
            evidence["columns"] = []
            evidence["indexes"] = []
            evidence["foreign_keys"] = []
    print(json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False, default=str, separators=(",", ":")))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.profile != PROFILE_GATE1:
        raise SystemExit("UNSUPPORTED_READ_ONLY_AUDIT_PROFILE")
    run_gate1()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def load(name, relative):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / relative)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def readonly_job():
    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-job.v2",
        "job_id": "readonly-sql-v6-regression",
        "target_repo": "rbalam/EDARSA_HUB",
        "target_branch": "Edarsahub_Desarrollo",
        "production_allowed": False,
        "objective": "regression",
        "human_summary_language": "es",
        "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
        "actions": [],
        "checks": [{"type": "sql_readonly_audit", "profile": "gate1_connections_internationalization"}],
    }


def test_bridge_accepts_readonly_mode_without_actions():
    bridge = load("bridge_readonly_v6", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    assert bridge.validate(readonly_job()) == []


def test_bridge_rejects_actions_in_readonly_mode():
    bridge = load("bridge_readonly_actions_v6", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    job = readonly_job()
    job["actions"] = [{"type": "write_file", "path": "x.txt", "content": "x"}]
    assert "READ_ONLY_ACTIONS_PROHIBITED" in bridge.validate(job)


def test_bridge_rejects_unknown_readonly_profile():
    bridge = load("bridge_readonly_profile_v6", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    job = readonly_job()
    job["checks"][0]["profile"] = "arbitrary"
    assert any("INVALID_READ_ONLY_PROFILE" in value for value in bridge.validate(job))


def test_audit_contract_has_no_arbitrary_sql_or_mutation_tokens():
    text = (ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/sql_readonly_audit.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "readonly_sql_connection" in text
    assert "--sql" not in text
    assert "parser.add_argument(\"--profile\", required=True)" in text


def test_publisher_certifies_readonly_without_sha_attestation():
    publisher = load("publisher_readonly_v6", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    evidence = publisher.certification_evidence({"status": "READ_ONLY_COMPLETE", "percent_complete": 100})
    assert evidence["certification"] == "READ_ONLY_EVIDENCE"
    assert evidence["work_completion"] == "COMPLETE"
    assert evidence["percent_complete"] == 100
